title: Committed-input early acceptance must use the newest terminal result and retain a recovered same-run registration
outcome: The existing early committed-input reader refuses an older PASS superseded by a newer terminal failure at the judged commit and continues using the original applicable registration after claim recovery on the same work run, preserving root, store and work-run checks.
acceptance: At the exact judged commit, the early committed-input reader selects the newest applicable terminal result before judging its outcome; a newer terminal failure cannot be bypassed by an older PASS. Other commits and nonmatching work/root/store results cannot decide that selection.

Recovering a claim on the same work run uses the applicable registration's original binding rather than requiring the current claim fence, preserves root/store/work-run checks, and does not fall back to the legacy sighting flow merely because the claim fence changed. Discriminating RED/GREEN tests cover both repairs; the final exact candidate receives the required review pair and FULL gate before landing.

completion.summary: Landed newest-terminal committed-input acceptance and original same-work-run recovery evidence preservation, including fail-closed unknown reads, Pending rereads and installed compacted registrations. Discriminating RED/GREEN, exact focused PASS28, Codex+Claude no Medium+, byte-identical current-master carry, standard exact-tree FULL and actual remote-master confirmation recorded. Two Low follow-ups and one pre-existing unreproduced race investigation remain optional.
